issues.description: Constructor parameter order is inconsistent with the problem statement/UML. The problem statement (and UML attribute order) instructs implementing the Lecture constructor in the same order as the UML: lectureName, numberOfInscribedStudents, numberOfGuestStudents, numberOfLecturers, numberOfTutors. The solution instead defines the constructor as (lectureName, numberOfLecturers, numberOfTutors, numberOfInscribedStudents, numberOfGuestStudents), which can mislead students and can cause signature-based tests to fail.
issues.suggestedFix: Align the solution (and expected tests) with the stated UML order by changing the constructor signature to: Lecture(String lectureName, int numberOfInscribedStudents, int numberOfGuestStudents, int numberOfLecturers, int numberOfTutors). Alternatively, if the solution order is intended, update the problem statement/UML text to explicitly specify that order.
